The nine sizes

EngravedTip widthThinnest tip wallNote

The same on all nine: 11.5 mm round hole for the boss around the screw, 4 mm corner radius, 5 mm tip depth, and the D-shaped bore for the motor shaft.

Finding the one that fits

  1. Pop one centre cap off the cube.
  2. Start with 15.75 and work upward. Push each tip straight into the recess with light finger pressure.
  3. Stop at the first one that will not go in. The one before it is your size.
  4. Check that it does not rock or twist in the recess. If it does, and the next size up will not go in, keep the looser one.
  5. Put the engraved number into TIP_SQ in cad/bench_stand.py and print five more.
Print settings

Standing on the wide round end with the tips up, 100% infill, 0.2 mm layers, no supports. The whole set is 66 × 66 × 29.5 mm and about 39 cm³ of plastic.
